'''Outpost Ghrent''' was an outpost owned along the Southern Cliffs in the [[Glarus Valley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Muir]] and [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Malichose]] were stationed at the outpost.<ref name="TOR" />
